categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main business segments: food safety rapid testing and animal diagnostics. The food safety segment includes rapid test reagents, instruments, and related services for detecting contaminants such as pesticide residues, veterinary drug residues, mycotoxins, microorganisms, illegal additives, and heavy metals in various food products. The animal diagnostics segment covers economic animals and companion animals, offering products for disease detection, pregnancy testing, and health management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages multidisciplinary technologies including chemistry and immunology, with core competencies in antigen and antibody self-development, high-efficiency sample pre-treatment, and automated intelligent detection platforms. It has developed proprietary gene-engineered recombinant antigen-antibody technology, monoclonal antibody screening, and small molecule modified antigen platforms. The company also utilizes rapid solid-phase extraction (SPE) techniques and chemical luminescence technology to enhance detection speed, sensitivity, and automation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include food production and processing enterprises, government regulatory agencies, trade companies, large dairy enterprises, source farms, and pet hospitals. The company serves markets involved in food safety monitoring, animal disease prevention, and pet health management. Major end markets span raw material inspection, production, processing, distribution, retail, and regulatory enforcement sectors domestically and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with significant domestic market penetration and is actively expanding its international presence. Its global sales network covers over 60 countries and regions including Europe, Asia, Africa, the Americas, Russia, South America, and the Middle East. It has subsidiaries and operations in the US, Singapore, Hong Kong, and multiple Chinese provinces.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of rapid detection reagents, instruments, and diagnostic services. It controls core raw material production such as antigens and antibodies, enabling a closed-loop system from raw materials to finished products and solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening international market expansion, enhancing enterprise-level customer cooperation, advancing intelligent and automated detection technologies, and developing a platform-based approach integrating multiple detection scenarios. R&D focuses on continuous innovation in antigen-antibody technology, sample pre-treatment, chemical luminescence platforms, and digital intelligent solutions to improve detection accuracy, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of rapid test reagents, diagnostic instruments, and testing services. The company employs a buyout sales model targeting food enterprises, government clients via bidding, and trade customers. It also derives income from government subsidies, investment returns, and financial product yields.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading high-tech enterprise in the domestic rapid detection industry, recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'little giant'. It holds a competitive edge through proprietary core technologies, comprehensive product lines, and international certifications such as AOAC and ILVO. It competes globally in food safety and animal diagnostics markets, with growing market shares in Europe, Asia, and emerging markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 224 million, with a 5.29% increase in food safety rapid testing and a 63.87% increase in animal diagnostics revenue. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 17.1 million, a significant turnaround from a loss in the prior year. The company maintains a total asset base of about RMB 1.46 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures around RMB 40 million, representing over 18% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes rapid, accurate, sensitive, and easy-to-use detection solutions with a full closed-loop system from core raw materials to instruments and services. Its self-developed antigen-antibody technology ensures product quality stability and cost advantages. The integration of automated intelligent detection platforms and digital data management enhances customer efficiency and compliance. The company’s products have achieved multiple international certifications and are recognized for replacing imported products in key markets.
